title: tetragonolobus siliquosus
intro: Tetragonolobus siliquosus, commonly known as Horse Bean or Four-angled Bean, is a leguminous vine plant native to Australia. The health benefits of Tetragonolobus siliquosus include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to act as a demulcent, a mild laxative, and an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Tetragonolobus siliquosus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
